text: following script intentionally compact. suitable first file new user creates installing OmniPhenoR.
code: library(OmniPhenoR)  # 1. Inspect available capabilities. pheno_capabilities()  # 2. Create a study object and load a teaching image. project <- pheno_project(   "leaf_health_demo",   metadata = list(sensor = "RGB") ) img <- pheno_data("leaf_rgb")  # 3. Screen acquisition quality. pheno_qc(img)  # 4. Inspect exact RGB formulas before using them. pheno_rgb_catalog("vegetation")  # 5. Compute visible traits. rgb <- pheno_rgb_summary(   img,   c("ExG", "NGRDI", "GLI", "VARI", "TGI") ) print(rgb)  # 6. Segment the leaf and inspect the mask. mask <- pheno_segment(   img,   index = "ExG",   threshold = "otsu",   min_size = 50 ) pheno_plot(mask, "mask")  # 7. Measure morphology. shape <- pheno_morphology(mask) print(shape)  # 8. Extract complementary texture traits. texture <- pheno_texture(   img,   methods = c("first_order", "glcm", "lbp", "gabor", "dwt"),   mask = mask,   levels = 16,   distances = c(1, 2),   angles = c(0, 90),   wavelengths = c(4, 8) ) print(texture)  # 9. Validate frozen numerical truths. pheno_validate("all")  # 10. Freeze provenance. audit <- pheno_audit(texture) print(audit$settings)  # 11. Generate a report skeleton. pheno_report(   pheno_pipeline(img, "leaf_health"),   "leaf_health_report.md",   "Leaf health phenotyping" )

title: OmniPhenoR: From RGB Leaf Images to Multiscale Digital Phenotyping
text: Pseudo-replication: treating image date independent plant. Silent interpolation: replacing missing acquisitions without recording values generated. Post-hoc clock selection: choosing calendar thermal time solely one produces stronger significance. -smoothing: eliminating biologically meaningful abrupt responses. Derivative -interpretation: estimating growth velocity irregular observations without sensitivity analysis. AUDPC without time scale: reporting area disease curve without stating whether time days, thermal units, standardized duration. Ignoring residual correlation: fitting repeated measurements residuals independent. Resampling time points: bootstrapping observations instead biological subjects. FPCA without interpretation: reporting FPC scores without examining eigenfunctions define . Environmental leakage: attaching future environmental information earlier phenotype observations.

title: OmniPhenoR 1.0.0
text: Consolidates capabilities developed 0.1.0 0.5.0. Preserves complete public-export union observed across five development generations. Restores eight longitudinal exports present 0.4.0 accidentally absent 0.5.0 development source: pheno_correlation_structures(), pheno_curve_compare(), pheno_event(), pheno_event_response(), pheno_growth(), pheno_model_diagnostics(), pheno_phenology(), pheno_series_qc(). Restores print.pheno_growth, print.pheno_repeated_fit, print.pheno_functional. Uses richer 0.4.0 longitudinal interface stable canonical API 0.5.0 development branch introduced incompatible simplified signatures. Retains non-conflicting 0.5.0 convenience entry points including pheno_gdd(), pheno_growth_fit(), pheno_growth_predict(), pheno_audpc(), pheno_interpolate(), pheno_time_gaps(), pheno_time_since_event(), pheno_missing_time(), pheno_time_validate_model(), pheno_curve_distance(). Consolidates 0.5.0 experiment, catalog, storage, manifest, MIAPPE, BrAPI, FAIR, privacy, lineage, snapshot, reproducibility-bundle infrastructure top 0.4.0 longitudinal core. Expands implementation registry 240 blocks: 32 0.1.0, 40 0.2.0, 50 0.3.0, 58 0.4.0, 60 0.5.0. Adds integrated v43-omniphenor-1.0-integrated-workflow.Rmd vignette. Maintains precompiled-vignette installation policy. Adds explicit API compatibility ledger integrated cross-version validation report.
